item.title: International Creativity and Innovation Award (ICIA)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The International Creativity and Innovation Award (ICIA), organized nationally by STEMEOC, provides a platform for young Cambodian students to showcase their creativity and problem-solving skills. At the national level, participants present innovative projects aimed at addressing real-world challenges, with a strong focus on aligning their solutions with the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The national winners then advance to the international stage, where they represent Cambodia and compete with young innovators from around the world. This global competition encourages collaboration, critical thinking, and the application of STEM knowledge to foster solutions for pressing global issues. The competition offers students valuable opportunities to engage with international experts, enhance their innovation skills, and refine their projects through workshops, hackathons, and mentoring sessions. ICIA not only supports innovation but also promotes networking and cross-cultural collaboration, empowering young people to become future leaders in STEM and innovation.

item.title: STEM Sisters
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
STEM Sisters Initiative

The STEM Sisters initiative, led by STEMEOC, is a dedicated program aimed at empowering young Cambodian women to pursue careers in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. This initiative seeks to break down barriers and provide opportunities for girls and young women to explore their potential in STEM fields.

Through workshops, mentorship programs, and hands-on activities, STEM Sisters equips participants with the skills, knowledge, and confidence to succeed in traditionally male-dominated industries. By fostering a supportive community, the program encourages young women to embrace STEM as a viable and exciting career path.

STEM Sisters also offers networking opportunities, connecting participants with female role models, professionals, and educators in STEM. The initiative’s focus on mentorship ensures that girls are not only inspired but also guided by women who have successfully navigated their own STEM journeys.

Through these efforts, STEM Sisters aims to close the gender gap in STEM and cultivate a new generation of confident, capable women leaders who will shape the future of Cambodia’s STEM landscape.

STEM Sisters Initiative

The STEM Sisters initiative, led by STEMEOC, is a dedicated program aimed at empowering young Cambodian women to pursue careers in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. This initiative seeks to break down barriers and provide opportunities for girls and young women to explore their potential in STEM fields.

Through workshops, mentorship programs, and hands-on activities, STEM Sisters equips participants with the skills, knowledge, and confidence to succeed in traditionally male-dominated industries. By fostering a supportive community, the program encourages young women to embrace STEM as a viable and exciting career path.

STEM Sisters also offers networking opportunities, connecting participants with female role models, professionals, and educators in STEM. The initiative’s focus on mentorship ensures that girls are not only inspired but also guided by women who have successfully navigated their own STEM journeys.

Through these efforts, STEM Sisters aims to close the gender gap in STEM and cultivate a new generation of confident, capable women leaders who will shape the future of Cambodia’s STEM landscape.

item.title: Eco-STEM
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The Eco Hero initiative, led by STEMEOC, is a program designed to inspire and educate young students about environmental sustainability through science and technology. This initiative empowers participants to become champions of environmental stewardship by engaging them in hands-on activities, workshops, and community-based projects focused on solving real-world ecological challenges. By blending STEM education with environmental responsibility, Eco Hero encourages students to innovate and create solutions that promote a sustainable future for Cambodia.

Through the Eco Hero initiative, students not only learn about sustainability but also actively participate in initiatives such as waste reduction, clean energy projects, and eco-friendly innovations. The program connects students with environmental experts, local organizations, and green technology companies, giving them the tools and inspiration to lead eco-conscious lives and careers. By nurturing a generation of environmentally aware young leaders, Eco Hero aims to address critical global and local challenges, positioning Cambodian youth at the forefront of sustainability and environmental innovation.

item.title: Cambodia Robotics Olympiad 2024 (CRO)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The Cambodian Robotics Olympiad

The Cambodian Robotics Olympiad, proudly organized by STEMEOC, is a prestigious national competition that inspires students to push the boundaries of creativity and innovation in robotics. Participants are challenged to design, build, and program robots to solve real-world problems, offering them a unique platform to showcase their talents. This exciting event features five diverse categories—RoboMission, Future Innovators, Future Engineers, Robot Sumo, and Robot Soccer—ensuring a variety of challenges that cater to different interests and skill levels.

Beyond the competition, STEMEOC enhances the experience with a dynamic Robotics Expo, where students can explore cutting-edge robotics technologies, engage in hands-on activities, and interact with professionals and companies at the forefront of the robotics industry. The Olympiad provides a pathway for the winning teams to compete on an international stage at the World Robotic Olympiad, representing Cambodia and showcasing their skills to a global audience. This opportunity not only opens doors for future career prospects but also fosters the next generation of STEM leaders. The event cultivates critical thinking, teamwork, and leadership while igniting a passion for STEM fields among young Cambodian innovators.

item.title: Annual STEM Festivals
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Annual Cambodian STEM Festival

The Annual Cambodian STEM Festival, organized by STEMEOC, showcases the largest student exhibit in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics in Cambodia. This dynamic event brings together students, educators, and professionals from across the country, offering a platform for students to display their innovations and projects.

With interactive exhibits, hands-on workshops, and live demonstrations, the festival allows participants to explore cutting-edge advancements in technology and science while discovering new and exciting career pathways. These activities aim to spark curiosity and inspire the next generation of leaders in STEM.

The festival also hosts competitions, encouraging students to apply creativity and critical thinking through eco-friendly projects and STEM challenges. Alongside these student-driven initiatives, the event provides opportunities for participants to network with STEM professionals, leading organizations, and academic institutions.

By fostering collaboration and connection, the Annual Cambodian STEM Festival plays a vital role in bridging education and industry, helping to advance STEM literacy and cultivate future talent in Cambodia’s rapidly evolving STEM ecosystem.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qBF2vCrlmA

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Background

Dené serves as the Executive Director of STEMEOC. Holding a Master’s degree in International Business Law from the London School of Economics and Political Science, Dené brings strategic thinking and a strong foundation in governance to her role. Dené’s background in both the public and private sectors equip her with the ability to navigate complex organizational challenges and implement long-term, sustainable growth strategies. With a focus on growth, Dené is committed to expanding the organization’s reach and influence through innovative programs, key partnerships, and a dedication to advancing Cambodia’s future in STEM. Her leadership aims to transform STEMEOC into a more dynamic and impactful force in Cambodia’s educational landscape.

Contact Information

dene@stemcambodia.ngo
+855 12 814 999 (Telegram Messenger)

item.title: team1
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Background

Dené serves as the Executive Director of STEMEOC. Holding a Master’s degree in International Business Law from the London School of Economics and Political Science, Dené brings strategic thinking and a strong foundation in governance to her role. Dené’s background in both the public and private sectors equip her with the ability to navigate complex organizational challenges and implement long-term, sustainable growth strategies. With a focus on growth, Dené is committed to expanding the organization’s reach and influence through innovative programs, key partnerships, and a dedication to advancing Cambodia’s future in STEM. Her leadership aims to transform STEMEOC into a more dynamic and impactful force in Cambodia’s educational landscape.

Contact Information

dene@stemcambodia.ngo
+855 12 814 999 (Telegram Messenger)

item.title: Sample Page
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:

Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.)

...or something like this:

The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://stemcambodia.ngo.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

item.title: About
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
About STEM EOC

Get to know who we are and what we do 

Our Story
Mission
Values
Our Story

The STEM Education Organisation for Cambodia (STEMEOC) is a locally registered NGO dedicated to cultivating a dynamic and passionate STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics)

At STEM Education Organisation for Cambodia (STEMEOC), we believe in empowering students to unlock their full potential through hands-on learning and real-world applications of STEM knowledge. Through our programs, we aim for students to gain exposure to emerging technologies, leadership opportunities, and a
supportive community that encourages their growth.

Mission

To inspire and empower the Cambodian youth to pursue careers in STEM through engaging and inclusive education initiatives.

Programs and Events

Get to know our flagship programs and events!

Flagship Programs and Events

The Annual Cambodian STEM Festival is a national event that showcases innovative projects, interactive exhibits, and workshops, inspiring students to explore the possibilities of science, technology, engineering, and math in shaping Cambodia’s future.

Details & prices

Cambodia Robotics Olympiad

The Cambodia Robotics Olympiad is a national competition where students showcase their robotics skills, serving as the official pathway for qualifying teams to represent Cambodia at the World Robot Olympiad.

Details & prices

We are excited to announce that the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 is fast approaching!

NewsDecember 22, 2025

We are excited to announce that the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 is fast approaching! The Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 is a vibrant celebration of the nation’s growing achievements in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics. Centered on the theme “Patterns and Programming: Discovering Math, Games, and Creativity through STEM,” this year’s festival explores how patterns form the foundation of both mathematics and computer programming, shaping the logic behind games, algorithms, and innovation. The festival provides an exciting platform for Cambodian students to present their ideas, featuring approximately 250 STEM projects and 1,000 creative exhibits that demonstrate how pattern recognition, coding,…

The Primary School Art Contest as part of CamSTEMFest 2026!

NewsNovember 28, 2025

 សេចក្ដីប្រកាស ស្ដីពីការប្រកួតគូរគំនូរសម្រាប់សិស្សកម្រិតបឋមសិក្សា! អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជា សូមប្រកាសជ្រើសរើសស្នាដៃគំនូរសម្រាប់ការប្រកួត និងដាក់តាំងបង្ហាញក្នុងមហោស្រពពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជា ឆ្នាំ២០២៦!   វិញ្ញាសា– បឋមកម្រិតទាប (Elementary)៖ ថ្នាក់ទី១-៣– បឋមកម្រិតខ្ពស់ (Junior)៖ ថ្នាក់ទី៤-៦  បញ្ជាក់៦– ផុតកំណត់ទទួល៖ ថ្ងៃទី២៣ ខែមករា ឆ្នាំ២០២៦– កាលបរិច្ឆេទមហោស្រព និងប្រកាសលទ្ធផល៖ ថ្ងៃសៅរ៍ ទី៧ ខែកុម្ភៈ ឆ្នាំ២០២៦– ទម្រង់នៃការប្រកួត៖ ជាលក្ខណៈបុគ្គល (មិនមែនប្រកួតជាក្រុម)– ទំហំក្រដាស៖ A3 (297 x 420 mm)– ប្រធានបទ៖ “The Art of Patterns: Tessellations” ការចូលរួមប្រកួត– បង្កើតស្នាដៃសិល្បៈគំនូរក្រោមប្រធានបទ “ទីក្រុងអនាគត”– យកស្នាដៃសិល្បៈគំនូរមកដាក់នៅការិយាល័យអង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជា (បន្ទប់លេខ៥៨ ជាន់ទី៥ អគារអាយខន លើបណ្ដាយមហោវិថីព្រះនរោត្តម) ឱ្យបានមុនម៉ោង ៤:០០ រសៀល នាថ្ងៃទី២៤ ខែមករា ឆ្នាំ២០២៥ តស់! ចូលរួមបញ្ចេញសមត្ថភាព និងការច្នៃប្រឌិតទាំងអស់គ្នាដើម្បីទីក្រុងអនាគត!  Calling all Young Artists!  Join us in the Primary School Art Contest as part of CamSTEMFest 2026!   Eligibility:– Lower Primary : Grades 1-3– Upper Primary: Grades 4-6  Important Details:– Deadline for submission: January 23rd , 2026– Exhibition and Results: Saturday, February 7th, 2026 (…

The Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 is Coming!🚀

NewsOctober 27, 2025

នឹកដល់ទិដ្ឋភាពដ៏រំភើបរីករាយពី “មហោស្រពពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជា” មែនទេ? និយាយអីចឹង! មហោស្រពរបស់យើងប្រចាំឆ្នាំ២០២៦ក៏កាន់តែកៀកមកដល់ហើយដែរ! តស់! មកទស្សនាវីដេអូបូកសរុបសកម្មភាពសំខាន់ៗកាលពីព្រឹត្តិការណ៍ឆ្នាំទៅទាំងអស់គ្នា! យើងរំឭកឡើងវិញនូវអនុស្សាវរីយ៍ល្អៗជាមួយគ្នា ទន្ទឹមនឹងការត្រៀមខ្លួនរួចជាស្រេច ដើម្បីអបអរសាទរការអប់រំវិទ្យាសាស្ត្រ បច្ចេកវិទ្យា វិស្វកម្ម និងគណិតវិទ្យា ក្នុងឆ្នាំ២០២៦ខាងមុខនេះ! Do you miss the excitement of the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival? Guess what — the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 is just around the corner! Watch this highlight video from last year to relive the moments, and get ready to be part of this amazing celebration of science, technology, engineering, and math! Highlight Video from 2025

item.content:encoded:
Shaping Cambodia’s Future Through STEM Education

STEMEOC provides educational programs and opportunities that equip students with the skills needed to make a lasting impact in Cambodia's STEM sectors.

Get in touch now Our Projects

What is STEM Education?

STEM education is an interdisciplinary approach to learning that integrates Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics to equip students with problem-solving, critical thinking, and innovative skills.

What is STEMEOC?

STEMEOC is a locally registered NGO dedicated to cultivating a dynamic and passionate STEM community amongst the Cambodian youth.

Why STEMEOC?

With a broad network of schools and a proven track record in STEM education, your support will help us scale our programs and shape the future of young innovators. Years of STEM Festivals 0 Public and Private schools in our network 0 + Visitors (18th ACSF) 0 Provinces reached through our programs 0

Among our supporters

Programs and Events

Get to know our flagship programs and events!

Annual Cambodian STEM Festival

The Annual Cambodian STEM Festival is a national event that showcases innovative projects, interactive exhibits, and workshops, inspiring students to explore the possibilities of science, technology, engineering, and math in shaping Cambodia’s future.

Details

Cambodia Robotics Olympiad

The Cambodia Robotics Olympiad is a national competition where students showcase their robotics skills, serving as the official pathway for qualifying teams to represent Cambodia at the World Robot Olympiad.

Details

Eco-STEM

STEMEOC's Eco-STEM Initiative empowers students to develop innovative, sustainable solutions for environmental challenges, fostering eco-conscious leadership and action in their communities.

Details

Our Strategic Priorities

STEMEOC follows 4 main strategic priorities to guide our efforts in creating impactful change across Cambodia’s STEM Education sector.

Empowerment

STEMEOC empowers students by providing access to technology and learning opportunities, equipping them with transferable STEM skills to lead and innovate in their communities.

Innovation

We foster a culture of innovation by encouraging creative problem-solving through STEM programs, competitions, and hands-on learning that address real-world challenges.

Growth

Our initiatives promote both personal and professional growth, helping students develop the knowledge and confidence needed to pursue STEM careers and drive Cambodia's development.

Community

STEMEOC builds strong communities by connecting students, educators, and industry leaders, creating a collaborative network focused on sustainability and future-ready solutions.
Nithijounie Dene Eang

Executive Director

Details
Sarky Soukamneuth

Chief Operating Officer

Details
Srey Borin

Program Director

Details
Lisa Math

Communications Coordinator

Details
Eam Hot

Event Coordinator

Details

The Importance of STEM Education

Inspiring future leaders through the power of Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics

"STEM education is the foundation for future innovation. Without it, we cannot hope to solve the world's most pressing problems." — Bill Gates

STEM education is crucial in preparing students for the future, equipping them with critical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills necessary to thrive in a rapidly changing world. It empowers young minds to innovate, address global challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, technologically advanced society. By fostering curiosity and hands-on learning, STEM paves the way for a brighter and more inclusive future.

item.title: 18th ANNUAL CAMBODIAN STEM FESTIVAL
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The 18th Annual Cambodia STEM Festival (ACSF) held at Aeon Mall Mean Chey on May 10-11, 2024, marked another successful year of inspiring innovation and promoting STEM education. Organized by the STEM Education Organization for Cambodia (STEMEOC) and STEAM Cambodia, with the esteemed endorsement of the Ministry of Environment (MoE), Ministry of Education, Youth, and Sport (MoEYS), and the Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology & Innovation (MISTI), the festival brought together students, educators, industry professionals, and government officials under the theme of "Sustainability through Green Innovation."

Supporting MoEYS' STEM Education Efforts

With 10,600 participants, including students, educators, and families, from 77 schools (47 public ), the 18th ACSF provided a valuable platform for promoting STEM education in line with the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports (MoEYS) initiatives. The festival offered an engaging and interactive environment where students could:

  • Showcase their projects in six key areas, sparking a passion for science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics (STEAM).
  • Engage with industry professionals and experts, gaining valuable insights and inspiration for future careers in STEM fields.

Supporting MoEYS' STEM Education Efforts

The 18th ACSF's focus on green innovation aligns perfectly with the Ministry of Environment's circular strategy. With 220 projects showcased, many addressed themes like waste reduction, resource recovery, and sustainable practices. By providing a platform for these projects, the 18th ACSF encourages students to think critically about environmental issues and develop solutions that promote a sustainable circular economy in Cambodia.

National Platform for Student Innovation

The 18th ACSF provided more than 5000 students an unmatched opportunity to display their ingenuity nationally. With 220 projects exhibited across six areas, the festival fostered a spirit of healthy competition and collaboration. This platform allowed students to:

  • Gain valuable experience presenting their ideas to a wider audience.
  • Receive feedback from industry professionals and peers, refining their skills and knowledge.
  • Network with like-minded individuals, fostering a supportive community for future innovation.

Organized by the STEM Education Organization for Cambodia (STEMEOC) and STEAM Cambodia, with the esteemed endorsement of the Ministry of Environment (MoE), Ministry of Education, Youth, and Sport (MoEYS), and the Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology & Innovation (MISTI), the festival brought together students, educators, industry professionals, and government officials under the theme of "Sustainability through Green Innovation."

The festival offered an engaging and interactive environment where students could:

  • Showcase their projects in six key areas, sparking a passion for science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics (STEAM).
  • Engage with industry professionals and experts, gaining valuable insights and inspiration for future careers in STEM fields.

item.title: ECO-HERO CLEANUP DAY: PROMOTING ENVIRONMENTAL STEWARDSHIP
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
On June 8, 2024, the STEM Education Organization for Cambodia (STEMEOC), in partnership with local authorities, students, and dedicated volunteers, successfully hosted the Eco-Hero Cleanup Day in Mean Commune, Ou Raing Ov District. This event was part of the larger “Clean Cambodia, Khmer Can Do It” campaign, a national movement aimed at raising awareness about environmental conservation and encouraging communities to take action in preserving their surroundings.

The Cleanup Day saw enthusiastic participation from students, volunteers, and representatives from the Ministry of Environment, who all worked together to clean public spaces, collect waste, and promote sustainable practices. 

We extend our heartfelt thanks to all participants, especially the Ministry of Environment team, for their unwavering support in making this event a success. Their involvement provided a significant boost to the Clean Cambodia, Khmer Can Do It campaign, underscoring the importance of collaborative efforts in creating lasting environmental change. Together, we are making a difference every day, fostering a cleaner, greener, and more beautiful Cambodia for future generations.

Let’s continue this mission by taking small, everyday actions to preserve our environment. Every effort counts in building a sustainable future!

item.title: CAMBODIA ROBOTICS OLYMPIAD 2024
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The Cambodia Robotics Olympiad (CRO) 2024, held on September 14, 2024, at AEON Mall Mean Chey, was a major event in promoting robotics and STEM education in Cambodia. Organized by STEM Education Organization Cambodia (STEMEOC) with the support of the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport and the Ministry of Environment, the event saw the participation of over 4,000 people. 

Under the theme “Earth Allies,” CRO 2024 encouraged students to develop innovative STEM solutions that contribute to a greener future. Participants from schools and universities across Cambodia competed in various robotics challenges. Key highlights of the event included:

  • National Robotics Competitions in categories such as Robomission, Future Innovators, Future Engineers, Robot Sumo, and Robot Soccer.
  • ECO Hero Academy, a space dedicated to raising awareness of environmental sustainability through interactive educational activities.
  • Robotics Expo, where visitors interacted with robots and learned about their applications in STEM education.
  • Interactive Zone, featuring live demonstrations of the latest technological advancements in robotics.

item.title: Plastic Waste Management Capacity Building Workshop 2025
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The event brought together 100 participants from 8 Community Protected Areas within the Keo Seima Wildlife Sanctuary — all united by one goal: to reduce plastic waste and protect biodiversity.

We were honored by the presence of the Mondulkiri Provincial Director of Environment, STEMEOC’s Executive Director, and a WCS Cambodia representative, whose support highlighted the importance of community-driven conservation efforts.

Together, we're empowering local communities to take meaningful action for a cleaner, greener future.

 

I. Background

The Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS) began its conservation work in Cambodia on December 1, 1999, responding to growing threats to globally significant ecosystems. Since then, WCS Cambodia has evolved into a major force for environmental protection, celebrating 25 years of impact in 2024.
Its main focus’s themes include Keo Seima Wildlife Sanctuary, Northern Plains Landscape, Tonle Sap Lake and Floodplain, Conservation Project, Koh Kong River Systems, and the Mighty Mekong River Corridor. WCS Cambodia blends scientific research, community engagement, and government partnerships to protect biodiversity while improving local livelihoods.

The STEM Education Organization for Cambodia (STEMEOC) has obtained financial support from WCS to execute a project entitled 'Sustainable Alternatives to Plastic Use and Conservation Education.' This initiative is entirely endorsed by the Ministry of Environment and will operate for five months, from May 1 to September 30, 2025. As part of the assignment, STEM will provide basic knowledge on plastic waste management, effective waste management, and alternative packaging to WCS Commune Protect Areas’ beneficiaries.

II. Workshop’s Objectives

The training program is to provide essential knowledge to participants regarding the detrimental effects of plastic waste on biodiversity, efficient waste management practices, and alternative packaging materials to plastics.

item.content:encoded:
On behalf of the STEM Education Organization for Cambodia, we are honored to participate in the official launch ceremony of the Digital Administration Program and the signing of the Memorandum of Understanding for the development and launch of the CHAKRA STEM App, in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment.

This meaningful partnership reflects our shared commitment to promoting environmental sustainability and supporting the next generation on the path to a greener future.

item.title: CRO 2025 – Road to WRO 2025!
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
This is your chance to innovate, compete, and represent Cambodia at the World Robot Olympiad in Singapore, happening November 26–28, 2025! iscing elit. Ut elit tellus, luctus nec ullamcorper mattis, pulvinar dapibus leo.

CRO Category

Robot Sumo 
Robot Soccer

WRO Category

 Robomission
 Future Innovators
 Future Engineers

WELCOME TO WRO® 2025

THE FUTURE OF ROBOTS

The WRO® theme for 2025 is The Future of Robots.

In 2025 teams will explore the way robotics can help solve global challenges and improve our lives. From robots reshaping our future cities, robots driving the expansion of life across the universe to AI-enabled robots improving all aspects of our life. The possibilities are endless. Through The Future of Robots, we can shape a future that holds solutions, drives progress, and brings a better tomorrow for mankind.

Overview<\/h2>

Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can\u2019t offer you a full refund or exchange.<\/p>

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.<\/p>

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.<\/p>

Additional non-returnable items:<\/h4>
  • Gift cards<\/li>
  • Downloadable software products<\/li>
  • Some health and personal care items<\/li>
  • To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.<\/li>
  • Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.<\/li><\/ul>

    There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:<\/h4>
    • Book with obvious signs of useCD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.<\/li>
    • Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.<\/li>
    • Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery<\/li><\/ul>

      Refunds<\/h2>

      Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.<\/p>

      If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.<\/p>

      Late or missing refunds<\/h3>

      If you haven\u2019t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.<\/p>

      Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.<\/p>

      Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.<\/p>

      If you\u2019ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at {email address}.<\/p>

      Sale items<\/h4>

      Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.<\/p>

      Exchanges<\/h2>

      We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at {email address} and send your item to: {physical address}.<\/p>

      Gifts<\/h4>

      If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you\u2019ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.<\/p>

      If the item wasn\u2019t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.<\/p>

      Shipping returns<\/h4>

      To return your product, you should mail your product to: {physical address}.<\/p>

      You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.<\/p>

      Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.<\/p>

      If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don\u2019t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.<\/p>

      Need help?<\/h2>

      Contact us at {email} for questions related to refunds and returns.<\/p>"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

Ngoun Sivgech

Graphic Designer


Background

a part time Graphic Designer for STEM Education Organization for Cambodia, an undergraduate student from CamTech University , passionate about creating visually practical elements for media and event products. It is fun to create creative design for the product and media posts, till the feedback comes.

Contact Information

nsivguech@stemcambodia.ngo



+855 85 727731 (Telegram Messenger)

item.title: Ronie Lina
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ronie Lina

Marketing Intern

Background

Lina Ronie is a Marketing Intern at STEM Education Organization for Cambodia. She is responsible for assisting in reaching out to companies, organizations, and ministries for partnership and sponsorship opportunities. She also helps ensure smooth communication between STEMEOC and stakeholders before, during, and after each event. With passion and professionalism, she is committed to promote STEM and STEAM Education among young students in Cambodia. Academically, she is a senior student majoring in International Relations at Paragon International University.

Contact Information

linaronie03@gmail.com
+855 924 666 93 (Telegram Messenger)

Background

Lina Ronie is a Marketing Intern at STEM Education Organization for Cambodia. She is responsible for assisting in reaching out to companies, organizations, and ministries for partnership and sponsorship opportunities. She also helps ensure smooth communication between STEMEOC and stakeholders before, during, and after each event. With passion and professionalism, she is committed to promote STEM and STEAM Education among young students in Cambodia. Academically, she is a senior student majoring in International Relations at Paragon International University.

item.title: Sokea Vatey
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sokea Vatey

Project Intern

Background

Hi! I’m Vatey, currently working as a Project Intern at STEMEOC. I’m passionate about making STEM more accessible and exciting, especially for students who don’t always get the opportunity. Before joining STEMEOC, I volunteered with Cambodia’s Ministry of Education to help students in Phnom Penh learn how to use technology for self-study. I’ve also supported events like the STI Day, and CIMO Math Competition, helping in event organization and promoting STEM Education for youth in Cambodia. Now at STEMEOC, I’m learning and contributing to projects that aim to inspire the next generation of innovators. I believe that with the right tools, support and inspirations, anyone can do amazing things in STEM.

Contact Information

vateysokea@gmail.com
+855 093 562 205 (Telegram Messenger)

item.title: Podcast
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
STEM Talks

STEM Talks aims to spotlight STEM pathways, careers, and opportunities for young people in Cambodia.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vsUfrqEf-c&list=RD4vsUfrqEf-c&start_radio=1

STEM Talks | Episode 1: Introducing STEM Talks

STEMEOC is pleased to announce the release of the first episode of our STEM Talks podcast, Introducing STEM Talks. In the first episode, our host Vatey Sokea introduces the podcast and shares why it was created, who it’s for, and what listeners can expect in upcoming episodes. Through these conversations, STEM Talks aims to spotlight STEM pathways, careers, and opportunities for young people in Cambodia. We hope you’ll stay tuned for future episodes featuring inspiring stories, practical insights, and voices from across Cambodia’s STEM community.

STEM Talks | Episode 2: Nithijounie Dene Eang

In the second episode of STEM Talks, host Vatey sits down with Nithijounie Dene Eang, Executive Director of STEMEOC. They explore Dene’s journey into leadership, the work STEMEOC is doing to expand access to STEM education, and the current STEM education landscape in Cambodia. The conversation also offers valuable advice for young people interested in pursuing pathways in STEM and leadership.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eTCU_A1p_d4https://youtu.be/OIc-Fbpvo8I

STEM Talks | Episode 3: Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 (Special Episode!)

In this special episode of STEM Talks, Vatey, Neary, and Piseth take us behind the scenes of the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026! Held on 7 February 2026 at Premier Sen Sok in Phnom Penh, this year’s festival showcased 337 STEM projects centered around the theme Patterns and Programming. Follow our host as she explores selected projects, and interviews students, teachers, and guests to capture the energy, creativity, and innovation that define Cambodia’s growing STEM community!

STEM Talks | Episode 4: Solita Pun

They explore Solita’s journey into robotics and the experiences that shaped her passion for STEM. Now pursuing a master’s degree in data science, Solita also shares insights on the growing role of robotics and AI in Cambodia and how these technologies are opening new opportunities for students. The conversation also touches on the importance of supporting women in STEM, the evolving STEM education landscape in Cambodia, and advice for young people who aspire to pursue careers in science and technology.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NTjH_Ir5BjY&t=9shttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uIwp1oW-rgw&t=144s

STEM Talks | Episode 5: ChanSocheata Poum

In the fifth episode of STEM Talks, host Vatey sits down with Chansocheata Poum. Socheata shares her journey into tech, the experiences that shaped her passion, and how she co-founded Snoopedu to make STEM learning more accessible for students in Cambodia. She also talks about her current work as Head of Makerspace at the Cambodia Academy of Digital Technology (CADT), where she focuses on assistive technology and innovation and even brings in a Braille printer she built to show live on the podcast.

STEM Talks | Episode 6: Solyda Teik

In the sixth episode of STEM Talks, host Vatey sits down with Solyda Teik, a Cambodian Technical Project Manager working in the aerospace industry in the United States at Blue Origin. Solyda shares her journey from Cambodia to South Korea and eventually into aerospace, reflecting on career pivots, moving across countries, and working on large-scale aerospace programs. She also gives listeners a glimpse into what it’s like inside large aerospace programs, and why careers in aerospace may be more accessible than many students imagine. Whether you are interested in engineering, aerospace, or exploring different career paths, this conversation offers insight into navigating career transitions and building opportunities across industries and countries.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1UD39jz9qu0https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uLvIQmWKLH8

STEM Talk | Episode 7: Andrew Roberts

In the seventh episode of STEM Talks, host Vatey sits down with Andrew Roberts, STEM Coordinator at the Cambodian Children's Fund (CCF). Andrew shares how he first came to Cambodia in 2016 and how he became involved in building CCF's STEM programme. Together, they discuss CCF and its flagship school, Neeson Cripps Academy (NCA), and their mission to transform the lives of some of the most impoverished children in Cambodia, particularly children from the former Steung Meanchey landfill community, by providing quality STEM education and direct support for children and their families. They also explore NCA's recent recognition as the World's Best STEM School at the 2026 Global Schools Prize and, most importantly, how students and supporters watching this video can get involved with CCF.

In the first episode, our host Vatey Sokea introduces the podcast and shares why it was created, who it’s for, and what listeners can expect in upcoming episodes. Through these conversations, STEM Talks aims to spotlight STEM pathways, careers, and opportunities for young people in Cambodia. We hope you’ll stay tuned for future episodes featuring inspiring stories, practical insights, and voices from across Cambodia’s STEM community.

In this special episode of STEM Talks, Vatey, Neary, and Piseth take us behind the scenes of the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026! Held on 7 February 2026 at Premier Sen Sok in Phnom Penh, this year’s festival showcased 337 STEM projects centered around the theme Patterns and Programming. Follow our host as she explores selected projects, and interviews students, teachers, and guests to capture the energy, creativity, and innovation that define Cambodia’s growing STEM community!

In the fifth episode of STEM Talks, host Vatey sits down with Chansocheata Poum. In the sixth episode of STEM Talks, host Vatey sits down with Solyda Teik, a Cambodian Technical Project Manager working in the aerospace industry in the United States at Blue Origin. Solyda shares her journey from Cambodia to South Korea and eventually into aerospace, reflecting on career pivots, moving across countries, and working on large-scale aerospace programs. She also gives listeners a glimpse into what it’s like inside large aerospace programs, and why careers in aerospace may be more accessible than many students imagine. Whether you are interested in engineering, aerospace, or exploring different career paths, this conversation offers insight into navigating career transitions and building opportunities across industries and countries.

item.content:encoded:
Partner with Us

Support our efforts by becoming a sponsor!

We’re seeking organizations and companies that share our vision to partner with us in delivering impactful STEM programs. Whether through co-hosting events, offering resources, or providing expertise, your partnership can help us take our initiatives to the next level.

How you can be a partner: Contribute expertise, resources, or collaborate on new educational programs.
Partner benefits: Gain visibility, connect with our growing network, and make a lasting impact on Cambodia’s STEM education landscape.

item.title: Volunteer
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Volunteer

Every volunteer makes a significant difference in our efforts.

Volunteers are the backbone of our programs, from organizing events to mentoring students. As a volunteer, you can get involved in hands-on STEM activities, assist at our annual events, or even lead educational workshops. Every volunteer makes a significant difference in our efforts.

What you’ll do: Support event management, mentor students, or help run workshops and programs.
Who can apply: Anyone passionate about STEM education and sustainability.

item.title: Internship
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Internship

Join us as an intern and gain valuable experience working on meaningful projects.

Join us as an intern and gain valuable experience working on meaningful projects. Our internships provide university students and recent graduates with the chance to develop skills in project management, STEM education, and communications, all while making a tangible impact in Cambodian communities

Who can apply: University students or recent graduates interested in STEM, education, or non-profit work.
What you’ll do: Assist with program development, event coordination, outreach, and more.

We invite you to become part of our mission to inspire and empower the next generation of innovators. Whether you want to volunteer your time, sponsor our programs, partner with us, or gain hands-on experience through an internship, your involvement will make a meaningful impact. If you're interested in joining us, please don’t hesitate to contact us for more information or to apply for any of these opportunities. Together, we can build a brighter future through STEM education!

item.title: STEM Education Organization for Cambodia Hosts Seed Funding Event on Plastic Management and Conservation with Over 400 Participants in Mondulkiri
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
This important event was honored by the presence of senior officials from the Ministry of Environment, the Mondulkiri Provincial Administration, the Provincial Department of Environment, representatives from partner organizations, seven community protected areas, and 31 students from both public and private educational institutions in Phnom Penh.

With over 400 participants in attendance, the program concluded with the announcement of five winning communities, recognized for their outstanding initiatives in environmental protection.

We remain committed to empowering communities for a sustainable future.

 អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជា បានរៀបចំកម្មវិធីប្រកួតប្រជែងមូលនិធិគម្រោងខ្នាតតូច សម្រាប់សកម្មភាពគ្រប់គ្រងប្លាស្ទិក និងការអភិរក្សធម្មជាតិ និងពិធីប្រគល់សម្ភារៈមិនមែនប្លាស្ទិកជូនដល់សមាជិកសហគមន៍តំបន់ការពារធម្មជាតិ ក្នុងស្រុកកែវសីមា នៅថ្ងៃទី១២ ខែសីហា ឆ្នាំ ២០២៥ នៅសាលាខេត្តមណ្ឌលគិរី ក្នុងក្រុងសែនមនោរម្យ ដោយមានការចូលរួមពីថ្នាក់ដឹកនាំក្រសួងបរិស្ថាន រដ្ឋបាលខេត្តមណ្ឌលគិរី មន្ទីរបរិស្ថានខេត្ត អង្គការដៃគូ តំណាងសហគមន៍តំបន់ការពារធម្មជាតិចំនួន៧ ទូទាំងស្រុកកែវសីមា និងសិស្សនិស្សិតមកពីវិទ្យាល័យ និងសាកលវិទ្យាល័យសាធារណៈ និងឯកជន ចំនួន ៣១ ក្នុងរាជធានីភ្នំពេញ។

សរុបមានអ្នកចូលរួមចំនួនជាង៤០០នាក់ ដែលបានអញ្ជើញចូលរួមក្នុងព្រិត្តការណ៍ដ៏មានសារៈសំខាន់មួយនេះ។ ជាលទ្ធផល សហគមន៍តំបន់ការពារធម្មជាតិចំនួន៥ បានទទួលជ័យលាភីពីការប្រកួតប្រជែង។

Event Highlights
item.excerpt:encoded: STEM Education Organization for Cambodia successfully organized a Seed Funding Competition aimed at promoting plastic management and nature conservation in community protected areas. The event took place at the Mondulkiri Provincial Hall in Senmonorom City, Keo Seima District.

item.title: Educational Trip to Keo Seima Wildlife Sanctuary, Mondulkiri Province
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
ដំណើរទស្សនកិច្ចសិក្សាទៅកាន់ដែនជម្រកសត្វព្រៃ ក្នុងខេត្តមណ្ឌលគិរី

អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្ត្រកម្ពុជានឹងរៀបចំដំណើរទស្សនកិច្ចសិក្សាទៅកាន់ដែនជម្រកសត្វព្រៃកែវសីមាដែលស្ថិតក្នុងខេត្តមណ្ឌលគិរី ដូចនេះប្អូនៗសិស្សវិទ្យាល័យ និង សកលវិទ្យាល័យ អាចធ្វើការចុះឈ្មោះចូលរួមអោយបានរួសរាន់ ។

 Date: August 12–14, 2025 (3 days, 2 nights)
 Location: Keo Seima Wildlife Sanctuary, Mondulkiri
 Limited Spots: Only 150 students
 Registration Deadline: 5th August 2025
 Registration Link : https://forms.gle/u6BwHAoXVKEta1fR8
 Field Trip - Mondulkiri (Telegram Group) : https://t.me/+AolxWnzuUL4zZDA1

Details: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1elY__DqzUiqfzZ3vv0p4aqHg7kRrWOa6/view?usp=drive_link

 All Expenses Covered – FREE!
 Transportation
 Accommodation
 All Meals (Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner)
 STEMEOC T-shirt
 Certificate of Participation
item.excerpt:encoded: The STEM Education Organization for Cambodia (STEMEOC) is excited to invite high school students and above to join our upcoming educational trip to Keo Seima Wildlife Sanctuary in the breathtaking Mondulkiri Province! 🏞✨

item.title: Educational trip to Keo Seima Wildlife Sanctuary, Mondulkiri Province
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
https://www.facebook.com/keoseimaredd

On behalf of STEMEOC, we are truly excited, grateful, and deeply honored that the Deputy Director of the Department of Environment and the Head of the Keo Seima Wildlife Sanctuary Office granted us the opportunity to lead this trip for our participating students. We hope that this field trip has provided the students with new experiences and valuable knowledge about forest conservation, wildlife, and biodiversity in the Keo Seima area. We also hope it will inspire them to share these insights with others and contribute to the protection of forests and biodiversity in Cambodia.

 «ដំណើរទស្សនកិច្ចសិក្សាទៅកាន់ដែនជម្រកសត្វព្រៃកែវសីមា ក្នុងខេត្តមណ្ឌលគិរី 🌴🌿🚌» កាលពីពេលថ្មីៗនេះ អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្ត្រកម្ពុជាបានរៀបចំដំណើរទស្សនកិច្ចសិក្សាទៅកាន់ដែនជម្រកសត្វព្រៃកែវសីមា ស្ថិតក្នុងខេត្តមណ្ឌលគិរី រយៈពេល ៣ថ្ងៃ ២យប់ គិតចាប់ពីថ្ងៃទី១២ ដល់ថ្ងៃទី១៤ ខែសីហា ឆ្នាំ ២០២៥។ គំនិតផ្ដួចផ្ដើមនេះទទួលបានការគាំទ្រក្រោមគម្រោង Keo Seima REDD+ Project ដែលបានផ្ដល់ឱកាសដល់ប្អូនៗសិស្សានុសិស្សមកពីសាលារដ្ឋនិងឯកជនសរុប៣១សាលា ក៏ដូចជានិស្សិតមកពីបណ្ដាសាកលវិទ្យាល័យនានាផងដែរ។ តាងនាមអង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្ត្រកម្ពុជា ពិតជាមានអារម្មណ៍រំភើបសប្បាយរីករាយនិងកក់ក្តៅបំផុត ដែលលោកអនុប្រធានមន្ទីរបរិស្ថានប្រចាំការទទួលបន្ទុកកិច្ចការពារ និងលោកប្រធានការិយាល័យដែនជម្រកសត្វព្រៃកែវសីមា បានអនុញ្ញាតឱ្យក្រុមការងារអង្គការយើងខ្ញុំមានឱកាស​ដឹកនាំប្អូនៗសិស្សានុសិស្សទាំងអស់មកចូលរួមដំណើរទស្សនកិច្ចមួយនេះ។ យើងខ្ញុំសង្ឃឹមថា តាមរយៈឱកាសដ៏អស្ចារ្យនេះ ប្អូនៗទាំងអស់ទទួលបានបទពិសោធនិងចំណេះដឹងថ្មីៗអំពីតំបន់អភិរក្សព្រៃឈើ សត្វព្រៃ និងជីវចម្រុះនៅក្នុងស្រុកកែវសីមា ហើយនឹងពាំនាំនូវគំនិតល្អៗ ដើម្បីផ្សព្វផ្សាយដល់អ្នកជុំវិញខ្លួន សំដៅរួមចំណែកការពារបរិស្ថានរបស់យើងទាំងអស់គ្នា។

Event Highlights
item.excerpt:encoded: STEM Education Organization for Cambodia organized a three-day, two-night educational field trip to the Keo Seima Wildlife Sanctuary in Mondulkiri Province, from August 12 to August 14, 2025. The program brought together students from 31 public and private high schools and universities in Phnom Penh. This initiative was supported by the Keo Seima REDD+ Project.

 «ដំណើរទស្សនកិច្ចសិក្សាទៅកាន់ដែនជម្រកសត្វព្រៃកែវសីមា ក្នុងខេត្តមណ្ឌលគិរី 🌴🌿🚌» កាលពីពេលថ្មីៗនេះ អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្ត្រកម្ពុជាបានរៀបចំដំណើរទស្សនកិច្ចសិក្សាទៅកាន់ដែនជម្រកសត្វព្រៃកែវសីមា ស្ថិតក្នុងខេត្តមណ្ឌលគិរី រយៈពេល ៣ថ្ងៃ ២យប់ គិតចាប់ពីថ្ងៃទី១២ ដល់ថ្ងៃទី១៤ ខែសីហា ឆ្នាំ ២០២៥។ គំនិតផ្ដួចផ្ដើមនេះទទួលបានការគាំទ្រក្រោមគម្រោង Keo Seima REDD+ Project ដែលបានផ្ដល់ឱកាសដល់ប្អូនៗសិស្សានុសិស្សមកពីសាលារដ្ឋនិងឯកជនសរុប៣១សាលា ក៏ដូចជានិស្សិតមកពីបណ្ដាសាកលវិទ្យាល័យនានាផងដែរ។ តាងនាមអង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្ត្រកម្ពុជា ពិតជាមានអារម្មណ៍រំភើបសប្បាយរីករាយនិងកក់ក្តៅបំផុត ដែលលោកអនុប្រធានមន្ទីរបរិស្ថានប្រចាំការទទួលបន្ទុកកិច្ចការពារ និងលោកប្រធានការិយាល័យដែនជម្រកសត្វព្រៃកែវសីមា បានអនុញ្ញាតឱ្យក្រុមការងារអង្គការយើងខ្ញុំមានឱកាស​ដឹកនាំប្អូនៗសិស្សានុសិស្សទាំងអស់មកចូលរួមដំណើរទស្សនកិច្ចមួយនេះ។ យើងខ្ញុំសង្ឃឹមថា តាមរយៈឱកាសដ៏អស្ចារ្យនេះ ប្អូនៗទាំងអស់ទទួលបានបទពិសោធនិងចំណេះដឹងថ្មីៗអំពីតំបន់អភិរក្សព្រៃឈើ សត្វព្រៃ និងជីវចម្រុះនៅក្នុងស្រុកកែវសីមា ហើយនឹងពាំនាំនូវគំនិតល្អៗ ដើម្បីផ្សព្វផ្សាយដល់អ្នកជុំវិញខ្លួន សំដៅរួមចំណែកការពារបរិស្ថានរបស់យើងទាំងអស់គ្នា។

item.content:encoded:
ក្រុមម្ចាស់ជ័យលាភី ទាំង៥ក្រុមពីកម្មវិធីប្រកួតប្រជែងមូលនិធិគម្រោងខ្នាតតូចសម្រាប់សកម្មភាពគ្រប់គ្រងប្លាស្ទិក និងការអភិរក្សធម្មជាតិ

1. ក្រុម : រយ៉ង (ជើងភ្នំបេង)
    ក្រោមប្រធានបទ : ការកាត់បន្ថយការប្រើប្រាស់ថង់ប្លាស្ទិកក្នុងសហគមន៍

2. ក្រុម : ភូមិពូចារ (ស្រែព្រះ)
    ក្រោមប្រធានបទ : ការផ្លាស់ប្តូរអាកប្បកិរិយា និងការយល់ដឹងអប់រំក្នុងសហគមន៍ ក្នុងភូមិពូចារ

3. ក្រុម : ភូមិពូគង់ (ស្រែព្រះ)
    ក្រោមប្រធានបទ : ការផ្លាស់ប្តូរអាកប្បកិរិយា និងការយល់ដឹងអប់រំក្នុងសហគមន៍

4. ក្រុម : ពូត្រុំ (អូរពុងរុង)
    ក្រោមប្រធានបទ : សកម្មភាពគ្រប់គ្រងប្លាស្ទិក និងការការពារធម្មជាតិ

5. ក្រុម : អណ្តូងក្រឡឹង (ឡែងកៅ)
    ក្រោមប្រធានបទ : ការផ្លាស់ប្តូរអាកប្បកិរិយា និងការយល់ដឹង

item.title: Cambodia Robotics Olympiad 2025 – Road to the World Stage! 🌍🚀
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Get ready for the biggest robotics showdown in Cambodia! The Cambodia Robotics Olympiad 2025 is just around the corner, and we’re inviting YOU to witness the future of tech in action!

 Top winners will earn the chance to represent Cambodia at the World Robot Olympiad 2025 in Singapore this November!

 National Round: September 6, 2025
 Time: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
 Venue: AEON Mall Mean Chey – AEON Hall (1st Floor)

Come support our young innovators and experience the excitement of robotics, creativity, and STEM at its best!

« កម្មវិធីប្រកួតប្រជែងរ៉ូបូតទិចកម្ពុជាឆ្នាំ២០២៥ (CRO 2025) »

អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្ត្រកម្ពុជាមានសេចក្ដីសោមនស្សរីករាយ សូមជម្រាបជូនលោកគ្រូ អ្នកគ្រូ មាតាបិតា អាណាព្យាបាល និងសិស្ស-និស្សិតទាំងអស់បានជ្រាបថា កម្មវិធីប្រកួតប្រជែងរ៉ូបូតទិចកម្ពុជាឆ្នាំ២០២៥​ នឹងប្រព្រឹត្តទៅក្នុងពេលឆាប់ៗខាងមុខនេះហើយ។

ដូច្នេះ សូមអញ្ជើញមកចូលរួមទស្សនា គាំទ្រ ក៏ដូចជាលើកទឹកចិត្តដល់នវានុវត្តន៍ជនវ័យក្មេងលើវិស័យស្ទែម និងរ៉ូបូតទិចរបស់កម្ពុជាយើងទាំងអស់គ្នា!

ចូលរួមទស្សនាដោយសេរី !

 កាលបរិច្ឆេទ ៖ ថ្ងៃទី​៦ ខែកញ្ញា ឆ្នាំ២០២៥ (ជុំប្រកួតជម្រុះនៅកម្ពុជា)
 ពេលវេលា ៖ ម៉ោង ៨:០០ ព្រឹក ដល់ ៤:០០ រសៀល
 ទីកន្លែង ៖ អុីអនម៉ល មានជ័យ (ក្នុងសាលជាន់ទី១)

 បញ្ជាក់៖ ចំពោះជ័យលាភីពីការប្រកួតប្រជែងនេះនឹងមានឱកាសធ្វើជាតំណាងប្រទេសកម្ពុជា ដើម្បីចូលរួមប្រកួតបន្តក្នុងកម្មវិធីប្រកួតប្រជែងរ៉ូបូតទិចអូឡាំព្យាដពិភពលោកឆ្នាំ២០២៥ ដែលគ្រោងនឹងរៀបចំឡើងក្នុងប្រទេសសិង្ហបុរី នាខែវិច្ឆិកាខាងមុខនេះ!

Get ready for the biggest robotics showdown in Cambodia! The Cambodia Robotics Olympiad 2025 is just around the corner, and we’re inviting YOU to witness the future of tech in action!

 Top winners will earn the chance to represent Cambodia at the World Robot Olympiad 2025 in Singapore this November!

 National Round: September 6, 2025
 Time: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
 Venue: AEON Mall Mean Chey – AEON Hall (1st Floor)

Come support our young innovators and experience the excitement of robotics, creativity, and STEM at its best!

« កម្មវិធីប្រកួតប្រជែងរ៉ូបូតទិចកម្ពុជាឆ្នាំ២០២៥ (CRO 2025) »

អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្ត្រកម្ពុជាមានសេចក្ដីសោមនស្សរីករាយ សូមជម្រាបជូនលោកគ្រូ អ្នកគ្រូ មាតាបិតា អាណាព្យាបាល និងសិស្ស-និស្សិតទាំងអស់បានជ្រាបថា កម្មវិធីប្រកួតប្រជែងរ៉ូបូតទិចកម្ពុជាឆ្នាំ២០២៥​ នឹងប្រព្រឹត្តទៅក្នុងពេលឆាប់ៗខាងមុខនេះហើយ។

ដូច្នេះ សូមអញ្ជើញមកចូលរួមទស្សនា គាំទ្រ ក៏ដូចជាលើកទឹកចិត្តដល់នវានុវត្តន៍ជនវ័យក្មេងលើវិស័យស្ទែម និងរ៉ូបូតទិចរបស់កម្ពុជាយើងទាំងអស់គ្នា!

ចូលរួមទស្សនាដោយសេរី !

 កាលបរិច្ឆេទ ៖ ថ្ងៃទី​៦ ខែកញ្ញា ឆ្នាំ២០២៥ (ជុំប្រកួតជម្រុះនៅកម្ពុជា)
 ពេលវេលា ៖ ម៉ោង ៨:០០ ព្រឹក ដល់ ៤:០០ រសៀល
 ទីកន្លែង ៖ អុីអនម៉ល មានជ័យ (ក្នុងសាលជាន់ទី១)

 បញ្ជាក់៖ ចំពោះជ័យលាភីពីការប្រកួតប្រជែងនេះនឹងមានឱកាសធ្វើជាតំណាងប្រទេសកម្ពុជា ដើម្បីចូលរួមប្រកួតបន្តក្នុងកម្មវិធីប្រកួតប្រជែងរ៉ូបូតទិចអូឡាំព្យាដពិភពលោកឆ្នាំ២០២៥ ដែលគ្រោងនឹងរៀបចំឡើងក្នុងប្រទេសសិង្ហបុរី នាខែវិច្ឆិកាខាងមុខនេះ!

item.title: 🎉 Congratulations to all the winners of CRO 2025 🏆
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Your hard work, passion, and dedication have truly paid off — you are all amazing!

We can’t wait to see you shine on the international stage as you represent Cambodia in Singapore. Make us proud!

អបអរសាទរជ័យលាភីពីការប្រកួតប្រជែងរ៉ូបូតទិចកម្ពុជា២០២៥

សមិទ្ធផលជាផ្លែផ្កាដែលសក្តិសមនឹងទទួលបាននេះកើតចេញពីការខិតខំប្រឹងប្រែង ការយកចិត្តទុកដាក់ និងឆន្ទៈដ៏មុតមាំរបស់ប្អូនៗយ៉ាងពិតប្រាកដ

ក្នុងនាមជាតំណាងប្រទេសកម្ពុជាចូលរួមជុំប្រកួតអន្តរជាតិក្នុងប្រទេសសិង្ហបុរីនាពេលខាងមុខនេះ និងដើម្បីជាមោទនភាពជូនជាតិ ចូរប្អូនៗខិតខំប្រឹងប្រែងបង្ហាញពីសមត្ថភាព និងភាពលេចធ្លោរបស់ខ្លួនឯងបន្តទៀត!

item.title: Ms. Eang Nithijounie Dene Shares Insights on Strengthening STEM Skills
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
On Sunday, September 28, 2025, Ms. Eang Nithijounie Dene, Executive Director of STEM Education Organization for Cambodia, was honoured to serve as a guest speaker at the kind invitation of His Excellency Dr. SANN Vathana, Head of Secretariat of Research, Creativity and Innovation Fund. She shared insights on strengthening STEM skills under the theme “Showcasing Scientific Achievements of Cambodian Young Women” at Preah Sisowath High School. On behalf of STEM Education Organization for Cambodia, we extend our heartfelt gratitude for this meaningful opportunity to inspire and empower young Cambodian women to realise their full potential through STEM education.

កាលពីថ្ងៃទី២៨ ខែកញ្ញា ឆ្នាំ២០២៥កន្លងទៅនេះ អ្នកស្រី អ៊ាង និធិជ្ជនីដឺណេ នាយិកាប្រតិបត្តិនៃអង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជា បានចូលរួមជាវាគ្មិនកិត្តិយស តបតាមការអញ្ជើញដ៏ខ្ពង់ខ្ពស់របស់ឯកឧត្តមបណ្ឌិត សាន វឌ្ឍនា ប្រធានលេខាធិការដ្ឋាន​មូលនិធិ​ស្រាវជ្រាវ​ គំនិត​ច្នៃប្រឌិត​ និង​នវានុវត្តន៍ ដើម្បីចែករំលែកអំពីការពង្រឹងជំនាញស្ទែម ក្រោមប្រធានបទ “ការដាក់តាំងបង្ហាញស្នាដៃវិទ្យាសាស្រ្តរបស់យុវតីកម្ពុជា” នៅវិទ្យាល័យព្រះសុីសុវត្ថិ។

តាងនាមអង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជា សូមថ្លែងអំណរគុណយ៉ាងជ្រាលជ្រៅបំផុតចំពោះឯកឧត្តមបណ្ឌិត ដែលបានផ្ដល់ឱកាសឱ្យយើងខ្ញុំចូលរួមលើកកម្ពស់ និងបំពាក់បំប៉នសមត្ថភាពយុវតីកម្ពុជាឱ្យបានស្គាល់ពីសក្ដានុពលដ៏ពេញលេញរបស់ខ្លួនឯង តាមរយៈការអប់រំស្ទែម!

item.title: The Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 is Coming!🚀
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
នឹកដល់ទិដ្ឋភាពដ៏រំភើបរីករាយពី "មហោស្រពពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជា" មែនទេ?

និយាយអីចឹង! មហោស្រពរបស់យើងប្រចាំឆ្នាំ២០២៦ក៏កាន់តែកៀកមកដល់ហើយដែរ!

តស់! មកទស្សនាវីដេអូបូកសរុបសកម្មភាពសំខាន់ៗកាលពីព្រឹត្តិការណ៍ឆ្នាំទៅទាំងអស់គ្នា! យើងរំឭកឡើងវិញនូវអនុស្សាវរីយ៍ល្អៗជាមួយគ្នា ទន្ទឹមនឹងការត្រៀមខ្លួនរួចជាស្រេច ដើម្បីអបអរសាទរការអប់រំវិទ្យាសាស្ត្រ បច្ចេកវិទ្យា វិស្វកម្ម និងគណិតវិទ្យា ក្នុងឆ្នាំ២០២៦ខាងមុខនេះ!

Do you miss the excitement of the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival?

Guess what — the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 is just around the corner!

Watch this highlight video from last year to relive the moments, and get ready to be part of this amazing celebration of science, technology, engineering, and math!

Highlight Video from 2025

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qBF2vCrlmA

item.title: The Primary School Art Contest as part of CamSTEMFest 2026!
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
សេចក្ដីប្រកាស ស្ដីពីការប្រកួតគូរគំនូរសម្រាប់សិស្សកម្រិតបឋមសិក្សា!

អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជា សូមប្រកាសជ្រើសរើសស្នាដៃគំនូរសម្រាប់ការប្រកួត និងដាក់តាំងបង្ហាញក្នុងមហោស្រពពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជា ឆ្នាំ២០២៦! 

 វិញ្ញាសា
- បឋមកម្រិតទាប (Elementary)៖ ថ្នាក់ទី១-៣
- បឋមកម្រិតខ្ពស់ (Junior)៖ ថ្នាក់ទី៤-៦

 បញ្ជាក់៦
- ផុតកំណត់ទទួល៖ ថ្ងៃទី២៣ ខែមករា ឆ្នាំ២០២៦
- កាលបរិច្ឆេទមហោស្រព និងប្រកាសលទ្ធផល៖ ថ្ងៃសៅរ៍ ទី៧ ខែកុម្ភៈ ឆ្នាំ២០២៦
- ទម្រង់នៃការប្រកួត៖ ជាលក្ខណៈបុគ្គល (មិនមែនប្រកួតជាក្រុម)
- ទំហំក្រដាស៖ A3 (297 x 420 mm)
- ប្រធានបទ៖ "The Art of Patterns: Tessellations"

ការចូលរួមប្រកួត
- បង្កើតស្នាដៃសិល្បៈគំនូរក្រោមប្រធានបទ “ទីក្រុងអនាគត”
- យកស្នាដៃសិល្បៈគំនូរមកដាក់នៅការិយាល័យអង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជា (បន្ទប់លេខ៥៨ ជាន់ទី៥ អគារអាយខន លើបណ្ដាយមហោវិថីព្រះនរោត្តម) ឱ្យបានមុនម៉ោង ៤:០០ រសៀល នាថ្ងៃទី២៤ ខែមករា ឆ្នាំ២០២៥

តស់! ចូលរួមបញ្ចេញសមត្ថភាព និងការច្នៃប្រឌិតទាំងអស់គ្នាដើម្បីទីក្រុងអនាគត!

 Calling all Young Artists! 

Join us in the Primary School Art Contest as part of CamSTEMFest 2026! 

 Eligibility:
- Lower Primary : Grades 1-3
- Upper Primary: Grades 4-6

 Important Details:
- Deadline for submission: January 23rd , 2026
- Exhibition and Results: Saturday, February 7th, 2026 ( The Premier Centre Sen Sok , Halls D, E, F & G)
- Submission Guidelines: Individual submissions only
- Artwork Size: A3 (297 x 420 mm)
- Topic: "The Art of Patterns: Tessellations"

To Enter:
- Create your artwork on the topic ‘Cities of the Future’
- Submit your artwork to our office at Icon Building E5 (5th Floor), #58, Norodom Blvd, Phnom Penh before 4:00 pm on January 24th, 2025.

For more Details and to Apply:
- Guideline : https://docs.google.com/.../120W5mrPCH.../edit...
- Application Form: https://forms.gle/PUqHGqyZmHwqGBU67
- Telegram Group: https://t.me/+h7ZW4AVpUg02NWM1
- Contact for Art Submissions : @brasithy

Let's get creative and bring the Cities of the Future to life!

- \u1791\u17c6\u17a0\u17c6\u1780\u17d2\u179a\u178a\u17b6\u179f\u17d6 A3 (297 x 420 mm)

item.title: Be a Sponsor & Partner of CamSTEMFest 2026!
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
ឱកាសឧបត្ថម្ភ និង/ឬសហការជាដៃគូរៀបចំមហោស្រពពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជាឆ្នាំ២០២៦! 

អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជាមានសេចក្ដីរីករាយសូមប្រកាសទទួលអ្នកឧបត្ថម្ភ​ និង/ឬដៃគូរៀបចំមហោស្រពពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជាឆ្នាំ២០២៦ ចាប់ពីថ្ងៃផ្សាយដំណឹងនេះតទៅ!

នេះជាឱកាសរបស់យើងទាំងអស់គ្នាក្នុងការកសាងប្រយោជន៍រួមយ៉ាងពិតប្រាកដ តាមរយៈការលើកកម្ពស់សមត្ថភាពនវានុវត្តន៍ជនជំនាន់ក្រោយ! 

អត្ថប្រយោជន៍ពីការចូលរួម
-បង្ហាញពីទំនួលខុសត្រូវសង្គម (CSR) ចំពោះវិស័យអប់រំនិងនវានុវត្តន៍:
-បង្កើនបណ្ដាញទំនាក់ទំនងជាមួយលោកគ្រូ អ្នកគ្រូ​ សិស្សានុសិស្ស និងអ្នកជំនាញឯកទេស។
-ចូលរួមផ្ដល់បទពិសោធស្ទែម ដើម្បីជំរុញការសិក្សាពេញមួយជីវិត។

 Be a Sponsor & Partner of CamSTEMFest 2026! 

Are you ready to make a real impact and empower the next generation of innovators? 

As a sponsor or partner, you’ll have the opportunity to:
- Showcase your brand’s commitment to education and innovation
- Connect with students, educators, and industry leaders
- Support hands-on STEM experiences that spark lifelong curiosity

 Join us today and be part of the change!

Contact us Via:
Phone: +855 69 626 898
E-mail: sponsor@stemcambodia.ngo​ / info@stemcambodia.ngo

 Date: 7th February 2026
 Time: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
 Venue: The Premier Centre Sen Sok - Halls (D, E, F & G)

item.title: We are excited to announce that the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 is fast approaching!
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
We are excited to announce that the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 is fast approaching!

The Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 is a vibrant celebration of the nation’s growing achievements in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics. Centered on the theme “Patterns and Programming: Discovering Math, Games, and Creativity through STEM,” this year’s festival explores how patterns form the foundation of both mathematics and computer programming, shaping the logic behind games, algorithms, and innovation.

The festival provides an exciting platform for Cambodian students to present their ideas, featuring approximately 250 STEM projects and 1,000 creative exhibits that demonstrate how pattern recognition, coding, and problem solving can be applied to real-world challenges.

In addition, the festival will feature a STEAM Career and Innovation Fair, offering students a chance to explore career opportunities where logic, design, games, and technology intersect. The festival highlights how mathematical thinking and computational creativity can empower the next generation to build Cambodia’s future through smart, innovative, and sustainable solutions. 
Theme: Patterns and Programming: Discovering Math, Games, and Creativity through STEM

OBJECTIVES

  1. Explore the power of patterns and programming: Engage participants in hands-on activities, games, and creative challenges that reveal how mathematics, logic, and computational thinking form the foundation of STEM learning
  2. Foster Curiosity and Innovation: Encourage students to think critically and creatively as they apply problem-solving skills to design solutions inspired by real-world applications
  3. Promote Collaborative Learning: Create opportunities for students, teachers, and mentors to share ideas, exchange knowledge, and work together on projects that bridge different STEM disciplines. 
  4. Inspire Future STEM Careers: Introduce students to exciting education and career pathways in fields where logic, design, and technology intersect 

    EVENT DETAILS

    • Event: The Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026
    • Date: 7th February 2026
    • Location: Premier Sen Sok Halls: D, E, F & G
    • Theme: “Patterns and Programming”: Discovering Math, Games, and Creativity through STEM

    HIGHLIGHTS & ACTIVITIES

    • STEM Performances
    • ECO-STEM Zone
    • Project Exhibition
    • Primary School Art Exhibition
    • Robotics Zone
    • Interactive Zone
    • STEAM Career Fair
    • Quizzes and Competitions
    • Post to Win
    • STEM Kids Zone
    TARGET AUDIENCES
    • Schools and educational institutions
    • Families and students
    • Government and ministries (MoEYS, MOE)
    • Private Sector and Industry Partners
    • NGOs and Development Partners
    • General Public and Media
    GET INVOLVED
    We invite all interested parties to participate in the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2025 :
    • STEM Project Exhibition : Registration Form
    • STEM Performance: Registration Form
    • Primary Art Drawing Contest : Registration Form
    • Sponsorship & Partnership Opportunities: Please contact us via info@stemcambodia.ngo / sponsor@stemcambodia.ngo

    YOU CAN ALSO JUST COME ALONG AND ENJOY THE Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 .
    Entry is free and we look forward to seeing you there.

We are excited to announce that the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026\u00a0is fast approaching!<\/strong><\/p>

The Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026 is a vibrant celebration of the nation\u2019s growing achievements in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics. Centered on the theme \u201cPatterns and Programming: Discovering Math, Games, and Creativity through STEM,\u201d this year\u2019s festival explores how patterns form the foundation of both mathematics and computer programming, shaping the logic behind games, algorithms, and innovation.<\/p>

The festival provides an exciting platform for Cambodian students to present their ideas, featuring approximately 250 STEM projects and 1,000 creative exhibits that demonstrate how pattern recognition, coding, and problem solving can be applied to real-world challenges.<\/p>

In addition, the festival will feature a STEAM Career and Innovation Fair, offering students a chance to explore career opportunities where logic, design, games, and technology intersect. The festival highlights how mathematical thinking and computational creativity can empower the next generation to build Cambodia\u2019s future through smart, innovative, and sustainable solutions.\u00a0

item.title: World Robot Olympiad 2025 - Global Stage
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
We are incredibly proud of our brilliant students who represented Cambodia on the global stage. Your passion, creativity, and determination inspire us all. Keep reaching for the stars!

So proud of each of you!

អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជាមានកិត្តិយស សូមចែករំលែកទិដ្ឋភាពសំខាន់ៗនៃកម្មវិធីប្រកួតរ៉ូបូតទិចអូឡាំព្យាដឆ្នាំ២០២៥ ពីប្រទេសសិង្ហបុរី! ជាមោទនភាពមួយរបស់យើងទាំងអស់គ្នាដែលប្អូនៗតំណាងប្រទេសកម្ពុជាបានចូលរួមប្រកួតប្រជែងយ៉ាងស្វិតស្វាញលើឆាកអន្តរជាតិជាមួយបេក្ខជនមកពីជុំវិញពិភពលោក។ ភាពច្នៃប្រឌិត ការប្ដេជ្ញាចិត្ត និងទឹកចិត្តប្រកួតប្រជែងដ៏មោះមុតរបស់ប្អូនៗជាកម្លាំងបំផុសស្មារតីមួយយ៉ាងពិតប្រាកដ!

Event Highlights

item.title: Women in Digital Leadership - Cambodia Digital Government Forum 2025
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
ស្រ្តីនៅក្នុងភាពជាអ្នកដឹកនាំឌីជីថល តាមរយៈវេទិការដ្ឋាភិបាលឌីជីថល អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជាពិតជាមានកិត្តិយសក្រៃលែង ដែលនាយិការប្រតិបត្តិរបស់យើងបានចូលរួមជាតំណាង និងជាវាគ្មិននៅក្នុងកិច្ចពិភាក្សាស្ដីពីស្រ្តីនៅក្នុងភាពជាអ្នកដឹកនាំឌីជីថល (Fireside Chat: Women in Digital Leadership) តាមរយៈវេទិការដ្ឋាភិបាលឌីជីថលឆ្នាំ២០២៥ ដែលបានប្រព្រឹត្តទៅកាលពីថ្ងៃទី៧ ខែធ្នូ ឆ្នាំ២០២៥ កន្លងទៅនេះ។

វេទិកានេះបានកៀរគរស្រ្តីជាអ្នកដឹកនាំ និងត្រួសត្រាយផ្លូវមុនគេក្នុងវិស័យនានាឱ្យចូលរួមចែករំលែកបទពិសោធដឹកនាំ ចក្ខុវិស័យ និងយុទ្ធសាស្រ្តផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន ក្នុងការជំរុញឱ្យប្រទេសកម្ពុជាឆ្ពោះទៅរកបរិវត្តកម្មឌីជីថលប្រកបដោយបរិយាបន្ន។

យើងរួមគ្នាជាកម្លាំងចលករដ៏សំខាន់ ដើម្បីបំផុសស្មារតីយុវតីជំនាន់ក្រោយ និងពង្រឹងភាពជាអ្នកដឹកនាំនៅគ្រប់ស្ថាប័នឱ្យមានបរិយាបន្ន។

      STEMEOC is deeply honored to have our Executive Director represent the STEM Education Organization for Cambodia as a speaker at the Fireside Chat: Women in Digital Leadership, held on 7 December 2025 as part of the Cambodia Digital Government Forum 2025.   This inspiring fireside chat brought together pioneering women leaders to share their leadership journeys, personal values, and strategies for driving inclusive digital transformation in Cambodia.   Together, we continue to inspire the next generation and strengthen inclusive leadership across institutions.      

Event Highlights

ស្រ្តីនៅក្នុងភាពជាអ្នកដឹកនាំឌីជីថល តាមរយៈវេទិការដ្ឋាភិបាលឌីជីថល អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជាពិតជាមានកិត្តិយសក្រៃលែង ដែលនាយិការប្រតិបត្តិរបស់យើងបានចូលរួមជាតំណាង និងជាវាគ្មិននៅក្នុងកិច្ចពិភាក្សាស្ដីពីស្រ្តីនៅក្នុងភាពជាអ្នកដឹកនាំឌីជីថល (Fireside Chat: Women in Digital Leadership) តាមរយៈវេទិការដ្ឋាភិបាលឌីជីថលឆ្នាំ២០២៥ ដែលបានប្រព្រឹត្តទៅកាលពីថ្ងៃទី៧ ខែធ្នូ ឆ្នាំ២០២៥ កន្លងទៅនេះ។

វេទិកានេះបានកៀរគរស្រ្តីជាអ្នកដឹកនាំ និងត្រួសត្រាយផ្លូវមុនគេក្នុងវិស័យនានាឱ្យចូលរួមចែករំលែកបទពិសោធដឹកនាំ ចក្ខុវិស័យ និងយុទ្ធសាស្រ្តផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន ក្នុងការជំរុញឱ្យប្រទេសកម្ពុជាឆ្ពោះទៅរកបរិវត្តកម្មឌីជីថលប្រកបដោយបរិយាបន្ន។

យើងរួមគ្នាជាកម្លាំងចលករដ៏សំខាន់ ដើម្បីបំផុសស្មារតីយុវតីជំនាន់ក្រោយ និងពង្រឹងភាពជាអ្នកដឹកនាំនៅគ្រប់ស្ថាប័នឱ្យមានបរិយាបន្ន។

item.title: A Memorable Moment at the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026!
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
ទិដ្ឋភាពសំខាន់ៗក្នុងវិធីមហោស្រពពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជាឆ្នាំ២០២៦! អង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជាសូមចែករំលែកកម្រងរូបភាពសំខាន់ៗនៃព្រឹត្តិការណ៍មហោស្រពពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជាឆ្នាំ២០២៦ ក្រោមមូលបទ «លំនាំ និងការសរសេរកម្មវិធី៖ ការស្វែងយល់អំពីគណិតវិទ្យា ហ្គេម និងការច្នៃប្រឌិតតាមរយៈស្ទែម» ក្នុងគោលបំណងលើកកម្ពស់សក្តានុពល និងការគិតបែបវិទ្យាសាស្ត្ររបស់យុវជនកម្ពុជា ហើយក៏ជាជាសមិទ្ធផលមួយដ៏ថ្មីសន្លាងរបស់យើងទាំងអស់គ្នាដើម្បីការអប់រំស្ទែមក្នុងប្រទេសកម្ពុជា។ ព្រឹត្តិការណ៍នេះបានប្រព្រឹត្តទៅដោយជោគជ័យ ក្រោមការគាំទ្រដ៏ខ្ពង់ខ្ពស់របស់ ក្រសួងអប់រំ យុវជន និងកីឡា ក្រសួងបរិស្ថាន, ក្រសួងឧស្សាហកម្ម វិទ្យាសាស្ត្រ បច្ចេកវិទ្យា និងនវានុវត្តន៍, ក្រសួងប្រៃសណីយ៍ និងទូរគមនាគមន៍, អ្នកឧបត្ថម្ភកម្មវិធី និងដៃគូសហការទាំងអស់។ យើងខ្ញុំសូមថ្លែងអំណរគុណយ៉ាងជ្រាលជ្រៅបំផុតចំពោះ បណ្តាក្រសួងនានា ព្រមទាំងដៃគូសហការនិងឧបត្ថម្ភជាច្រើនទៀត។ ការគាំទ្រនិងរួមចំណែកទាំងអស់នេះបានក្លាយជាប្រយោជន៍រួមដើម្បីការអប់រំស្ទែមនិងនវានុវត្តន៍ក្នុងប្រទេសកម្ពុជា! យើងរួមគ្នាជំរុញការអភិវឌ្ឍភាពច្នៃប្រឌិតនិងវឌ្ឍនភាពនៃការអប់រំស្ទែមបន្តទៅមុខជានិច្ច។       A Memorable Moment at the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026! We are delighted to share unforgettable highlights from one of Cambodia’s largest STEM events, the Annual Cambodia STEM Festival 2026, held under the theme “Patterns and Programming: Discovering Math, Games, and Creativity Through STEM.” This remarkable event was made possible through the incredible support of the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport, the Ministry of Environment, the Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology & Innovation, and the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications. We also extend our heartfelt appreciation to our esteemed sponsors and partners for standing alongside us in this impactful celebration. Your continued support plays a vital role in advancing STEM education, innovation, and sustainable development in Cambodia.

item.title: STEMEOC and International Partners Brief H.E. Kim Sethany on Milestone ICIA 2026 Preparations
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
កម្ពុជាត្រៀមខ្លួនធ្វើជាម្ចាស់ផ្ទះនៃព្រឹត្តិការណ៍ ICIA 2026 Global Round ក្រោមការគាំទ្រយ៉ាងពេញទំហឹងពីក្រសួងអប់រំ យុវជន និងកីឡា

ក្រុមការងារអង្គការពិព័រណ៍វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជា (STEMEOC) មានកិត្តិយសបានចូលជួបសម្ដែងការគួរសម និងពិភាក្សាអំពីកម្មវិធីប្រកួតប្រជែង ICIA 2026 Global Round ជាមួយលោកជំទាវបណ្ឌិត គឹម សេដ្ឋានី រដ្ឋលេខាធិការប្រចាំការក្រសួងអប់រំ យុវជន និងកីឡា អមជាមួយក្រុមការងារ ICIA Global International Team តំណាងសាលាអន្តរជាតិផារ៉ាហ្គន និងក្រុមការងារ AIESEC។

ជាមោទនភាពសម្រាប់កម្ពុជាក្នុងការសហការធ្វើជាម្ចាស់ផ្ទះរៀបចំព្រឹត្តិការណ៍លំដាប់ថ្នាក់អន្តរជាតិនេះឡើង។ ជាពិសេស សម្រាប់ការប្រកួតជុំជម្រុះក្នុងឆ្នាំនេះ យើងទទួលបានបេក្ខជនកើនឡើងដល់ទៅ ៣ដង ដែលជាសមិទ្ធផលប្រវត្តិសាស្ត្រសបញ្ជាក់ពីការរីកចម្រើននៃវិស័យស្ទែម (STEM) នៅកម្ពុជា។

        STEMEOC had the honor of meeting with H.E. Kim Sethany, Permanent Secretary of State of the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports, alongside the ICIA Global International Team, representatives from Paragon International School, and the AIESEC team. During the meeting, we presented our preparations for the upcoming ICIA 2026 Global Round, with Cambodia proudly serving as a co-host country. We are truly encouraged by the Ministry’s strong support in making this international event a success. We are also proud to share that this year’s National Selection saw a threefold increase in participating teams, setting a new record.        This remarkable achievement was warmly recognized by Her Excellency, marking an exciting milestone for STEM development in Cambodia.

Dates: 24–26 April 2026 Location: Phnom Penh, Cambodia Venue: Paragon International School Together, we are committed to advancing STEM education in Cambodia. We look forward to welcoming you all—mark your calendars! អំពីកម្មវិធី៖
  • 📅 កាលបរិច្ឆេទប្រកួត៖ ថ្ងៃទី២៤ ដល់ ២៦ ខែមេសា ឆ្នាំ២០២៦
  • 📍 ទីកន្លែង៖ សាលាអន្តរជាតិផារ៉ាហ្គន (រាជធានីភ្នំពេញ)

ចូលរួមទាំងអស់គ្នា ដើម្បីការអប់រំស្ទែមនៅកម្ពុជា! ✨📌

item.title: ICIA Global Round 2026 has officially begun here in Cambodia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Day 1 was all about warm welcomes, new connections, and unforgettable first impressions—from our campus tour to a vibrant welcoming buffet dinner bringing together participants from around the world. We’re proud to host such an incredible global community and share the spirit, culture, and hospitality of Cambodia with you all. Welcome to Cambodia—let the journey begin!

item.title: Day 2 of ICIA Global Round 2026 – Cambodia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Day 2 of ICIA Global Round 2026 – Cambodia
What an incredible day filled with learning, creativity, and connection! From an inspiring workshop for teachers and students, to the engaging Educators Meetalk, followed by the exciting project exhibition competition and rigorous judging sessions — every moment was full of innovation and passion. We ended the day on a high note with an unforgettable Cultural Night celebrating diversity, talent, and unity across nations. Check out our photo album and relive the energy, inspiration, and memories of Day 2!

item.title: Lisa Math
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Background

      Lisa serves as the Communications Coordinator for the STEM Education Organisation for Cambodia (STEMEOC). In this role, she leads the strategic direction of public relations, media engagement, and community outreach to advance digital literacy and STEM advocacy across the country.

     Lisa collaborates closely with educators, national ministries, and industry stakeholders to enhance the public visibility of major educational initiatives. Her work ensures that programs like hands-on youth workshops and national tech exhibitions effectively reach and inspire students nationwide.

     Passionate about equitable education, Lisa leverages impactful communication to build vibrant local tech communities. Her storytelling elevates the values of engaged learning and gender equality, aligning directly with STEMEOC's mission to drive Cambodia's future sustainable economic growth.

Skills

Public Relations Media Engagement Community Outreach Digital Literacy STEM Advocacy

item.title: Sarky Soukamneuth
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Chief Operating Officer

Background

 

Chief Operating Officer

Applied Mathematics Computer Science MBA Certified 25+ Years C-Level

With degrees in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science, and an MBA certification, Sarky brings over 25 years of leadership experience at C-Levels in both the private and non-governmental sectors. He specializes in building business and IT strategies that drive measurable results and align with organizational goals. Sarky has a proven track record in customer relationship management and leading high-impact, cost-effective projects. A strong believer in the power of education, Sarky is passionate about expanding access to STEM learning. As a key member of STEMEOC's leadership team, he is committed to guiding the organization through its next phase of growth and innovation.

Contact

sarky@stemcambodia.ngo @sourasack

Chief Operating Officer

Applied Mathematics Computer Science MBA Certified 25+ Years C-Level

With degrees in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science, and an MBA certification, Sarky brings over 25 years of leadership experience at C-Levels in both the private and non-governmental sectors. He specializes in building business and IT strategies that drive measurable results and align with organizational goals. Sarky has a proven track record in customer relationship management and leading high-impact, cost-effective projects. A strong believer in the power of education, Sarky is passionate about expanding access to STEM learning. As a key member of STEMEOC's leadership team, he is committed to guiding the organization through its next phase of growth and innovation.

item.title: Nithijounie Dene Eang
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Background

 

Executive Director · STEMEOC

Dené is the Executive Director of STEMEOC, where she leads the organisation's vision, partnerships, and programme development. Drawing on her experience across sectors, she focuses on strengthening governance and driving sustainable growth. Motivated by a commitment to expanding education opportunities, she is dedicated to growing STEMEOC into a leading national platform for STEM programmes and initiatives.

Through Dené's leadership, STEMEOC is envisioned as a driving force in expanding access to meaningful STEM education opportunities for students across Cambodia.

Contact Information

dene@stemcambodia.ngo stemcambodia.ngo Phnom Penh, Cambodia
