item.title: Te Henglay
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Background

IT Coordinator · STEMEOC

Full Stack · Mobile · AI Engineer



Next.js

Flutter

iOS & Android

AI Engineering

Te Henglay is a Cambodian IT professional and developer with expertise in full stack web development, mobile app development, and AI engineering. He builds modern web applications with Next.js, cross-platform and native mobile apps with Flutter, iOS, and Android, and integrates intelligent AI solutions into real-world products.

Currently serving as IT Coordinator at STEMEOC, he is passionate about leveraging technology to create meaningful digital experiences and contribute to Cambodia's growing tech ecosystem.

Focus Areas


Building scalable web & mobile products


Integrating AI into real-world applications


Growing Cambodia's tech ecosystem

IT Coordinator · STEMEOC

Full Stack · Mobile · AI Engineer

Next.js Flutter iOS & Android AI Engineering

Te Henglay is a Cambodian IT professional and developer with expertise in full stack web development, mobile app development, and AI engineering. He builds modern web applications with Next.js, cross-platform and native mobile apps with Flutter, iOS, and Android, and integrates intelligent AI solutions into real-world products.

Currently serving as IT Coordinator at STEMEOC, he is passionate about leveraging technology to create meaningful digital experiences and contribute to Cambodia's growing tech ecosystem.

Focus Areas

Building scalable web & mobile products

Integrating AI into real-world applications

Growing Cambodia's tech ecosystem

item.title: Cambodia Robotics Olympiad
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Get Involved with us https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ouj-iHiXBrQ

🎉 Cambodia Robotics Olympiad 2024

Relive the excitement of CRO 2024 with our official Highlight Video! 🎥🔥
Experience the unforgettable moments, inspiring performances, and the spirit of competition that brought students, mentors, and tech enthusiasts together.

The video captures the intensity, teamwork, and innovation that made this year’s event truly special.

👉 Watch now and feel the energy of CRO 2024!
item.excerpt:encoded: The Cambodia Robotics Olympiad is a national competition where students showcase their robotics skills, serving as the official pathway for qualifying teams to represent Cambodia at the World Robot Olympiad.

item.title: Annual Cambodian STEM Festival
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Annual Cambodian STEM Festival

The Annual Cambodian STEM Festival is a national event that showcases innovative projects, interactive exhibits, and workshops, inspiring students to explore the possibilities of science, technology, engineering, and math in shaping Cambodia’s future.

Get Involved with us https://stemcambodia.ngo/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Video-996694051876668.mp4

🎉 Cambodia STEM Festival

The first day of the Cambodia STEM Festival was a resounding success! 🤩
From groundbreaking projects to captivating performances, the creativity and innovation on display were truly inspiring.

We’re excited to invite you to Day 2 of the festival, happening on May 11th, from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM, at AEON Mall – Mean Chey.

🌟 Don’t miss out on a day filled with exploration, discovery, and hands-on experiences.
Come celebrate the future of STEM with us!

item.title: Pun Solita
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Background

Pun Solita is a dynamic Cambodian STEM educator, researcher, and Robotics & Makerspace Coordinator dedicated to advancing technology education and innovation. Her expertise spans Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and hands-on robotics engineering.

Driven by a passion for accessible education, Solita speaks at major regional forums — including the Educators MeeTalk in Phnom Penh — advocating for AI integration in inclusive learning environments. She serves as a lead instructor and mentor for the Cambodia Robotics Olympiad workshop series.

As an alumnus of E2STEM Education Cambodia, she secured 1st place at the Mekong River Commission River Monitoring Technology Competition in Vientiane, Laos, and served as a key programmer for the Cambodian national team, earning a global robotics silver medal in Dubai.

MRC Competition · Vientiane

🥇 1st Place — River Monitoring Technology

World Robotics · Dubai

🥈 Silver Medal — Cambodian National Team

National Initiative

🎓 Lead Instructor, Cambodia Robotics Olympiad

Skills

Artificial Intelligence Data Science Robotics Engineering Makerspace Education STEM Advocacy

item.title: Eam Hot
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Background

Eam serves as an Event and Project Coordinator at STEMEOC, leveraging her background in Business Administration (from PUC) to drive project execution, stakeholder engagement, and organizational management in support of national digital literacy goals.

Her experience in NGO environments helps her build collaborative partnerships and execute multi-stakeholder initiatives.

Eam is passionate about community development, applying her skills to organize educational workshops, competitions, and outreach programs aimed at empowering Cambodian youth.

Skills



Project Management


Event Coordination


Community Development


NGO Management

item.title: Cambodia Robotics Olympiad 2026 – Road to WRO 2026! 🌍🚀
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
We’re thrilled to announce that registration is now OPEN for the Cambodia Robotic Olympiad 2026!
     This is your chance to innovate, compete, and represent Cambodia at the World Robot Olympiad in Puerto Rico, happening December 8–10, 2026!


    ត្រៀមខ្លួនចូលរួមកម្មវិធីប្រកួតប្រជែងរ៉ូបូតទិចកម្ពុជាឆ្នាំ២០២៦ (CRO 2026) »
អង្គការពិព័រណ៌វិទ្យាសាស្រ្តកម្ពុជាមានសេចក្ដីសោមនស្សរីករាយ សូមជម្រាបជូនលោកគ្រូ អ្នកគ្រូ មាតាបិតា អាណាព្យាបាល និងសិស្សានុសិស្សទាំងអស់បានជម្រាបថា យើងចាប់ផ្តើមទទួលចុះឈ្មោះបេក្ខជនចូលរួមកម្មវិធីប្រកួតប្រជែងរ៉ូបូតទិចកម្ពុជាឆ្នាំ២០២៦ ចាប់ពីថ្ងៃផ្សាយដំណឹងនេះទៅហើយ!
    តាមរយៈការប្រកួតប្រជែងនេះ ប្អូនៗនឹងមានឱកាសបញ្ចេញសមត្ថភាព ប្រកួតប្រជែង និងធ្វើជាតំណាងប្រទេសកម្ពុជា ដើម្បីចូលរួមប្រកួតបន្តក្នុងកម្មវិធីប្រកួតប្រជែងរ៉ូបូតទិចពិភពលោកឆ្នាំ២០២៦ ដែលគ្រោងនឹងរៀបចំឡើងនៅថ្ងៃទី៨ ដល់ទី១០ ខែធ្នូ ឆ្នាំ២០២៦ ក្នុងប្រទេស Puerto Rico!
CRO 2026 Overview:
https://docs.google.com/.../1cYPToozxPYjWwkOEZ.../edit...

WRO Categories (for International Round):
Robomission (30$/Team)
Future Innovators (30$/ Team)
Future Engineers (30$/ Team)

Registration Form :
https://docs.google.com/.../1eba2fA6SbAQKyoO2dmh4vn0.../edit

WRO Categories - Telegram Group Chat:
https://t.me/+agW6bsK2sXA0N2I1

CRO Categories:
Robot Sumo (15$/Team)
Robot Tug of War (15$/ Team)

CRO Categories - Registration Form
- Robot Sumo: https://forms.gle/keA1m9M2AsVSaZnJ9
- Robot Tug of War: https://forms.gle/6fsMzwqpRxNRz1JQ7

CRO Categories - Telegram Group Chat:
https://t.me/+aNg6vhVS0bs1NzA1

Date: 5th September 2026
Time : 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM
Venue: AEON Mall Mean Chey – AEON Hall (1st Floor)

item.title: Sokea Vatey
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Background

 

Podcast Lead & Program Facilitator · STEMEOC

STEM Access · Youth Empowerment · Education

Vatey is currently working as a Project Intern at STEMEOC. She is passionate about making STEM more accessible and exciting, especially for students who don't always get the opportunity.

Before joining STEMEOC, she volunteered with Cambodia's Ministry of Education to help students in Phnom Penh learn how to use technology for self-study. She has also supported events like STI Day and the CIMO Math Competition, helping in event organization and promoting STEM education for youth in Cambodia.

Now at STEMEOC, she is learning and contributing to projects that aim to inspire the next generation of innovators. She believes that with the right tools, support, and inspiration, anyone can do amazing things in STEM.

Skill

Outreach

Community Outreach Event Organisation

Education

STEM Education Advocacy Digital Literacy

Project Work

Project Coordination Youth Programme Support

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Background

 

Graphic Designer · STEMEOC

Design · Media · Visual Communication

CamTech University Undergraduate Student Graphic Designer

Ngoun Sivgech is a part-time Graphic Designer for the STEM Education Organisation for Cambodia (STEMEOC) and an undergraduate student at CamTech University. She is passionate about creating visually practical elements for media and event products.

It is fun to create creative designs for products and media posts — till the feedback comes.

Focus Areas

Visual design for media & events

Creative product & social media design

STEM education visual communication

Skill

Design

Graphic Design Visual Communication

Media

Social Media Design Event Branding

Tools

UI/UX & Layout Design Creative Concept Development

item.title: Ronie Lina
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Background

Marketing Intern · STEMEOC

Partnerships · Outreach · STEM Advocacy

Paragon International University International Relations Senior Student

Lina Ronie is a Marketing Intern at the STEM Education Organisation for Cambodia (STEMEOC). She is responsible for assisting in reaching out to companies, organisations, and ministries for partnership and sponsorship opportunities.

She also helps ensure smooth communication between STEMEOC and stakeholders before, during, and after each event. With passion and professionalism, she is committed to promoting STEM and STEAM education among young students in Cambodia.

Academically, she is a senior student majoring in International Relations at Paragon International University.

Focus Areas

Partnership & sponsorship outreach

Stakeholder communication & event support

Promoting STEM & STEAM education for youth

Skill

Marketing

Marketing & Promotions Partnership Outreach

Communication

Stakeholder Communication Event Coordination

Advocacy

STEM & STEAM Education International Relations

Marketing Intern · STEMEOC

Partnerships · Outreach · STEM Advocacy

Paragon International University International Relations Senior Student

Lina Ronie is a Marketing Intern at the STEM Education Organisation for Cambodia (STEMEOC). She is responsible for assisting in reaching out to companies, organisations, and ministries for partnership and sponsorship opportunities.

She also helps ensure smooth communication between STEMEOC and stakeholders before, during, and after each event. With passion and professionalism, she is committed to promoting STEM and STEAM education among young students in Cambodia.

Academically, she is a senior student majoring in International Relations at Paragon International University.

Focus Areas

Partnership & sponsorship outreach

Stakeholder communication & event support

Promoting STEM & STEAM education for youth

Background

 

Office Support · STEMEOC

Operations ·  Administration

Ros Brasithy serves as an Office Support staff member at STEMEOC, assisting with daily operations, data management, and administrative coordination.

With experience in project support and reporting, he contributes to maintaining efficient workflows and ensuring smooth organisational operations.

Focus Areas

Data management & project reporting
